title: Malay is not Indonesian
description_en: Honor explicit ms versus id, document language and uncertainty; shared phrases such as Terima kasih are insufficient to choose the language or region.
requirement: Honor explicit ms versus id, document language and uncertainty; shared phrases such as Terima kasih are insufficient to choose the language or region.

title: Guarded Jawi support
description_en: Separate exact preservation, direction/shaping checks and native proofreading. Do not claim full Jawi support or transliterate Jawi into Rumi to evade an unsupported task.
requirement: Separate exact preservation, direction/shaping checks and native proofreading. Do not claim full Jawi support or transliterate Jawi into Rumi to evade an unsupported task.

title: Independent context axes
description_en: Keep language, script, region, register, medium, role and expression independent; ms-MY does not by itself prove Rumi or a formal voice.
requirement: Keep language, script, region, register, medium, role and expression independent; ms-MY does not by itself prove Rumi or a formal voice.

title: Explicit span metadata
description_en: Preserve explicit span language and script over inherited defaults. Arab is a script label, not proof of Arabic language; unknown context remains unresolved.
requirement: Preserve explicit span language and script over inherited defaults. Arab is a script label, not proof of Arabic language; unknown context remains unresolved.

title: Source and derived layers
description_en: Preserve text order, invisible characters, stable names and original metadata. Keep comparison/search keys and editorial suggestions separate with traceable diffs.
requirement: Preserve text order, invisible characters, stable names and original metadata. Keep comparison/search keys and editorial suggestions separate with traceable diffs.

title: Meaning and voice protection
description_en: Keep conditions, negation, quantities, actors and quotations. Layout pressure does not authorize deleting a condition, standardizing dialogue or changing a brand's case.
requirement: Keep conditions, negation, quantities, actors and quotations. Layout pressure does not authorize deleting a condition, standardizing dialogue or changing a brand's case.

title: Advisory editing boundary
description_en: Flag semantic, regional and author-intent questions for review. A likely correction does not grant permission to rewrite or to convert Malay into Indonesian.
requirement: Flag semantic, regional and author-intent questions for review. A likely correction does not grant permission to rewrite or to convert Malay into Indonesian.

title: di prefix versus preposition
description_en: Review disusun and di rumah through word function and context; do not join or separate every occurrence of di using a string replacement.
requirement: Review disusun and di rumah through word function and context; do not join or separate every occurrence of di using a string replacement.

title: Compound spelling
description_en: Preserve reka bentuk and susun atur, consult an identified regional dictionary and version, and avoid treating a fixed list of joined compounds as timeless completeness.
requirement: Preserve reka bentuk and susun atur, consult an identified regional dictionary and version, and avoid treating a fixed list of joined compounds as timeless completeness.

title: Lexical reduplication
description_en: Preserve buku-buku and distinguish its lexical hyphen from a temporary line-end hyphen; never remove repetition to fit a label.
requirement: Preserve buku-buku and distinguish its lexical hyphen from a temporary line-end hyphen; never remove repetition to fit a label.

title: Particles and register
description_en: Review -lah and pun by grammatical function and established exceptions; bacalah is not automatically slang and pun cannot be globally joined.
requirement: Review -lah and pun by grammatical function and established exceptions; bacalah is not automatically slang and pun cannot be globally joined.

title: Inclusive and exclusive reference
description_en: kami and kita differ in who is included. Explain any suggested change of responsibility or audience, leaving the original source intact.
requirement: kami and kita differ in who is included. Explain any suggested change of responsibility or audience, leaving the original source intact.

title: Dialogue and regional voice
description_en: A formal brief may justify an advisory note about tak or Jom, while quotations and dialogue remain protected. Region does not prescribe a single voice.
requirement: A formal brief may justify an advisory note about tak or Jom, while quotations and dialogue remain protected. Region does not prescribe a single voice.

title: Mixed-language and brand spans
description_en: Separate a loanword, foreign quotation and official product name before proposing spelling or English-titlecase changes.
requirement: Separate a loanword, foreign quotation and official product name before proposing spelling or English-titlecase changes.

title: Formatter and editorial contracts
description_en: Preserve quantities, dates and currency codes. Conflicting DBP examples or house styles need an identified edition and context rather than global comma/space replacement.
requirement: Preserve quantities, dates and currency codes. Conflicting DBP examples or house styles need an identified edition and context rather than global comma/space replacement.

title: Long affixed words
description_en: Adjust width and ordinary word wrapping before proposing hyphenation. Do not substitute English or Indonesian dictionaries, break all letters or remove meaning.
requirement: Adjust width and ordinary word wrapping before proposing hyphenation. Do not substitute English or Indonesian dictionaries, break all letters or remove meaning.

title: Jawi characters and variants
description_en: Test چ ڠ ڤ ڽ ݢ ۏ and preserve ڬ separately; this probe is not the complete Jawi repertoire and does not authorize replacing ga variants.
requirement: Test چ ڠ ڤ ڽ ݢ ۏ and preserve ڬ separately; this probe is not the complete Jawi repertoire and does not authorize replacing ga variants.

title: Joining and mark placement
description_en: Contextual forms belong to the shaping engine and font. Do not replace logical text with presentation forms; cmap coverage alone is not correct shaping.
requirement: Contextual forms belong to the shaping engine and font. Do not replace logical text with presentation forms; cmap coverage alone is not correct shaping.

title: Logical direction and extraction
description_en: Keep Jawi in logical order, declare known RTL paragraphs and isolate complete LTR amounts, URLs and phone spans when needed. Never reverse strings to imitate RTL.
requirement: Keep Jawi in logical order, declare known RTL paragraphs and isolate complete LTR amounts, URLs and phone spans when needed. Never reverse strings to imitate RTL.

title: Segmentation and controls
description_en: Keep grapheme/mark relationships, ZWJ and ZWNJ intact. Avoid Latin tracking, arbitrary tatweel and per-codepoint font changes across joining runs.
requirement: Keep grapheme/mark relationships, ZWJ and ZWNJ intact. Avoid Latin tracking, arbitrary tatweel and per-codepoint font changes across joining runs.

title: Malay OpenType language
description_en: Distinguish Malay MLY from Malayalam MAL. Record actual font, version, hash, language selection and glyph results; a language table alone is not certification.
requirement: Distinguish Malay MLY from Malayalam MAL. Record actual font, version, hash, language selection and glyph results; a language table alone is not certification.

title: Optical Rumi and Jawi balance
description_en: Compare actual body size, marks, baseline, line clearance and fallback in the selected medium; no universal Rumi-to-Jawi pixel multiplier is justified.
requirement: Compare actual body size, marks, baseline, line clearance and fallback in the selected medium; no universal Rumi-to-Jawi pixel multiplier is justified.

title: Purpose and measured evidence
description_en: Choose reading, display or hybrid structure from the task. Keep published design tokens, isolated observed examples and design starting values distinct.
requirement: Choose reading, display or hybrid structure from the task. Keep published design tokens, isolated observed examples and design starting values distinct.

title: Host-specific acceptance
description_en: Test real zoom, reflow and applicable text spacing separately, then reopen Office/PDF output and verify fonts, extraction and reading order. Static checks do not certify these hosts.
requirement: Test real zoom, reflow and applicable text spacing separately, then reopen Office/PDF output and verify fonts, extraction and reading order. Static checks do not certify these hosts.
